# HiGHS for the Ji scheduling experiment

highs-js 1.16.0 provides the locally served ES module and WebAssembly runtime. The source release uses the MIT license, included in LICENSE. The checked-in distribution contains the upstream highs.mjs and highs.wasm files unmodified.

- [Package release](https://www.npmjs.com/package/highs/v/1.16.0)
- [Wrapper source](https://github.com/lovasoa/highs-js)
- [HiGHS solver](https://github.com/ERGO-Code/HiGHS)
